description: Breaking change, a person's decision: rename a field's key (what the site's code reads). The values follow, formulas and the schema are updated, and the old key keeps working as an alias — delivery serves the value under both keys, and get_schema lists it under `aliases` — until a person removes it in Field settings, so the site never breaks mid-change. Nothing changes until a person confirms it on a trusted Mapled screen by typing the field's name (returns a reviewUrl to send to the user); poll get_confirmation. After it is applied: update the code to read the new key, regenerate the types, push the manifest. A refusal (key taken, malformed key) comes back at once. It can be undone from Field settings.

newKey.description: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, up to 50 characters.

name: rename_field
